title: Business Analyst
text:
Business Analyst - Example Insurance Pvt Ltd, Mumbai
2 to 5 years

You will
- Gather business requirements and write BRDs and user stories
- Map as-is and to-be processes in Visio
- Write SQL to check data for change requests
- Plan and run UAT with business users
- Work in Agile sprints with developers and testers

You need
- Requirements gathering
- Process mapping
- SQL and Excel
- UAT
- Agile

Good to have
- Power BI
- Jira

Work from office, Lower Parel.
